北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，湿度大，体感舒适。早晚温差注意添衣。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy with high humidity. Dress appropriately for temperature changes.

慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感闷热。注意防暑补水，保持清爽心情。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and feels muggy. Stay hydrated and keep cool!

上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy and muggy. Drive safe and stay hydrated, please.
